∀ {n : Nat} {adj : Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin n) (Fin n) Int},
  Etingof.IsDynkinDiagram n adj →
    ∀ (k : Type u) [inst : Field.{u} k] {Q : Quiver.{0, 0} (Fin n)},
      Etingof.IsOrientationOf.{0} Q adj →
        ∀ [∀ (a b : Fin n), Subsingleton.{1} (Quiver.Hom.{0, 0} a b)],
          And (Set.Finite.{0} (setOf.{0} fun d => Etingof.IsPositiveRoot n adj d))
            (And
              (∀ (ρ : Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.{u, 0, 0, 0} k (Fin n))
                [∀ (v : Fin n), Module.Free.{u, 0} k (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.obj.{u, 0, 0, 0} ρ v)]
                [∀ (v : Fin n), Module.Finite.{u, 0} k (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.obj.{u, 0, 0, 0} ρ v)],
                Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.IsIndecomposable.{u, 0, 0, 0} ρ →
                  Etingof.IsPositiveRoot n adj fun v =>
                    Nat.cast.{0} (Module.finrank.{u, 0} k (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.obj.{u, 0, 0, 0} ρ v)))
              (∀ (α : Fin n → Int),
                Etingof.IsPositiveRoot n adj α →
                  And
                    (Exists.{u + 2} fun ρ =>
                      Exists.{0} fun x =>
                        Exists.{0} fun x =>
                          And (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.IsIndecomposable.{u, 0, 0, u} ρ)
                            (∀ (v : Fin n),
                              Eq.{1} (α v)
                                (Nat.cast.{0}
                                  (Module.finrank.{u, u} k (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.obj.{u, 0, u, 0} ρ v)))))
                    (∀ (ρ₁ ρ₂ : Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.{u, 0, 0, 0} k (Fin n))
                      [∀ (v : Fin n), Module.Free.{u, 0} k (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.obj.{u, 0, 0, 0} ρ₁ v)]
                      [∀ (v : Fin n), Module.Finite.{u, 0} k (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.obj.{u, 0, 0, 0} ρ₁ v)]
                      [∀ (v : Fin n), Module.Free.{u, 0} k (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.obj.{u, 0, 0, 0} ρ₂ v)]
                      [∀ (v : Fin n), Module.Finite.{u, 0} k (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.obj.{u, 0, 0, 0} ρ₂ v)],
                      Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.IsIndecomposable.{u, 0, 0, 0} ρ₁ →
                        Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.IsIndecomposable.{u, 0, 0, 0} ρ₂ →
                          (∀ (v : Fin n),
                              Eq.{1} (α v)
                                (Nat.cast.{0}
                                  (Module.finrank.{u, 0} k (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.obj.{u, 0, 0, 0} ρ₁ v)))) →
                            (∀ (v : Fin n),
                                Eq.{1} (α v)
                                  (Nat.cast.{0}
                                    (Module.finrank.{u, 0} k (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.obj.{u, 0, 0, 0} ρ₂ v)))) →
                              Nonempty.{1} (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.Iso.{u, 0, 0, 0, 0} ρ₁ ρ₂))))
